certification: principal Coupled CP; saved outward verified confidence endpoints
selection_objective: minimum number of cells among completed passing certificates; preserved threshold-search local ties
family: union of the two preserved fixed-tree pruning families and all calibration-estimated-order contiguous partitions; no mixed families
order: exact (2*T_i+1)/(2*N_i+2), immutable-ID ties; source order validated
selection_inputs: saved calibration counts, region, cell evidence, order, fixed trees and immutable identifiers only
inference_budgets: actual G*max(selected completed cell U) globally; actual G*U_C cellwise; G*c is a ceiling only
target_interpretation: illustrative binary-mean total width, not a clinically established IHDP requirement
stages: I3 true aggregate assignment singleton boxes and actual aggregate outcome CP bounds at certified transport
comparisons: consecutive caps and each nonidentity-cap index versus cap 1, paired within original blocks; method differences versus shared raw stratification

uncertainty.means_and_differences: pointwise normal 95% Monte Carlo intervals over the 100 independent blocks per law/profile/cohort/cap; paired within block
uncertainty.binary_rates: two-sided exact 95% Clopper-Pearson with actual independent-block denominator; do not pool heterogeneous conditions
uncertainty.assignment_unit: one block per law/cap; no duplication across outcome profiles or cohorts
uncertainty.population_unit: one block per law/profile/cap; no duplication across outcome cohort sizes
uncertainty.conditional: admitted-only widths descriptive with actual denominators; unconditional failures and targets retain all 100 blocks
uncertainty.coverage: assignment event simultaneous over partitions/caps; outcome guarantees pointwise for a prespecified analysis, not simultaneous over frontier

execution.preflight_source: existing release-study development blocks, one per law
execution.cache_scope: per block, complete exact input keys including allocation, numerical policy, partition, outcome boxes and actual budgets
execution.timing_scope: additional computation with saved evidence and shared caches; not a cold end-to-end benchmark

interpretation: retrospective matched empirical operating curves; no globally optimal compression-width frontier or adaptive outcome-based cap choice
